offline_verification.restricted_attempts: Three restricted-process attempts were interrupted or timed out at unchanged thread-backed fake-controller checks. The same complete selection passed outside that restriction; the exact restriction mechanism is unproven.

limitations: No live campaign uses this post-freeze change yet.

The original uncertain campaign remains an incomplete infrastructure outcome, not a scientific rejection or recovered execution.
